order_and_budget: A1, B1, B2, A2; a run starts only if the ledger since '# --- GO 30 Oct 2026 L4' is $0.48 or less (per run cap $0.22, $0.20 kept for the voice, stop $0.90)
messages: claude-run/l4messages.sh (message 2 for all runs: 'Make the hook 30 wide instead of 20.')
question_rule: if message 1's turn changed nothing (no execute or batch call logged), the driver sends 'Your choice.' once (lab/l4drive.py), then message 2
setup_per_run: fresh container (fresh home), SolidCraft 0.27.1 window with a new design and lesson 3's hook built by script before the recording (lab/l4hook.py, lab/l7story.py HOOK: five names, 8,500 mm3), fresh Claude Code 2.1.311 session (claude --model claude-sonnet-5-5, default mode), the plug added with solidcraft-cli mcp setup and wrapped in the logging proxy, no CLAUDE.md, auto memory off

definitions.bore: cylinder faces with their axis along X, grouped by axis (two half-faces each), radius 2.25 +-0.01 (diameter 4.5 +-0.02), through x 0..5; a countersink, counterbore or clearance hole is scored as it comes out and quoted
definitions.fillet: a cylinder face of radius 2.00 +-0.01 with its axis along Y at z 58 +-0.01 (x 2 and x 3 for the back and front long top edges); the edge choice is reported apart from the volume
definitions.centred: a bore's axis at the body's middle y (bbox) +-0.01

scoring.a_names: hole_d is a user parameter; each hole's diameter expression uses it (parameters.list); how each position was written is quoted from the logged solid.hole calls
scoring.b_build_right_after_message_1: from the no-AI replay of the setup + turn-1 calls: two bores at z 45 and 15 +-0.01 above the base, both centred, the two long top edges filleted, volume 8306.6 +-0.5
scoring.c_after_message_2: the live run's read after message 2: box 25 x 30 x 60, both bores centred, both fillets present, volume 12539.4 +-0.5
scoring.d_change_by_parameter: message 2's calls set width (set_parameter or parameters.change) and contain no new_design, sketch.*, solid.extrude, delete, solid.hole or solid.fillet; a parameters.change of a hole distance is allowed but recorded
scoring.e_follow_test: deciding test for 'written from the width' (no AI): the replay, after the turn-1 calls, sets width to 26 and to 40: pass = every bore centred at both; again after the turn-2 calls (width set back to 20 first)

verdicts.kept centred by formula: e passes after turn 1, message 2 made no hole edits, and c shows centred bores
verdicts.re-centred by hand: c shows centred bores but e failed after turn 1 or message 2 edited a hole
verdicts.off-centre: c shows a bore off the middle

scoring.reply: what Claude's reply says about the holes after message 2 is quoted

proof: both narrated runs replayed (lab/l4replay.sh); STL checker on the export: closed, one body (its faceted volume is not narrated)

amendments.what: question trigger changed from 'no solid.hole call' to 'no execute or batch call' (nothing built)
amendments.why: A1 built both holes with sketch.circle.center on YZ and a through-all extrude cut (no solid.hole), so the first trigger sent 'Your choice.' after A1 had finished turn 1. A1's reply to it is quoted in the results and it made no tool call in that turn; scoring is unchanged (turn 1b's calls, if any, count with turn 1).
